uk-community-life-2024-25.name: UK DCMS Community Life Survey 2024/25 (England): neighbourhood and community, civic engagement

belonging.name: Belonging to the immediate neighbourhood
belonging.passage: 62% of adults felt they belonged 'very strongly' or 'fairly strongly' to their immediate neighbourhood, a 1 percentage point increase from 2023/24 (61%).

trust-neighbours.name: Many people in the neighbourhood can be trusted
trust-neighbours.passage: 40% of adults reported that many of the people in their neighbourhood can be trusted, no significant change from 2023/24 (41%).

chat-neighbours.name: Chatting to neighbours at least once a month
chat-neighbours.passage: 69% of adults reported that they chatted to their neighbours, more than just to say hello, at least once a month

pull-together.name: People in the neighbourhood pull together to improve it
pull-together.passage: 56% of adults definitely or tend to agree that people in their neighbourhood pull together to improve the neighbourhood, no significant change from 2023/24 (56%).

area-got-worse.name: Local area has gotten worse to live in
area-got-worse.passage: Conversely, 30% reported that it had gotten worse, a small, but significant, increase from 2023/24 (29%).

satisfied-local-area.name: Satisfied with the local area as a place to live
satisfied-local-area.passage: 73% of adults were either very or fairly satisfied with their local area as a place to live

different-backgrounds.name: Local area is a place where people from different backgrounds get on well
different-backgrounds.passage: 81% of adults definitely or tended to agree that their local area is a place where people from different backgrounds get on well together

green-space-litter.name: Rubbish and litter (reason for dissatisfaction with local green spaces)
green-space-litter.passage: rubbish and litter (54%), poor maintenance (51%) and dog fouling (45%)

green-space-lack.name: Lack of green and natural spaces locally
green-space-lack.passage: a perceived lack of these types of spaces in their local area (60%)

influence-local-decisions.name: Can personally influence decisions affecting the local area
influence-local-decisions.passage: 24% of adults agreed (either "definitely" or "tended" to agree) that they can personally influence decisions affecting their local area.
